audit.whatIsWrong: Vayne's R is called "On the Chase" / "On the Hunt" in spikes[1], whys[4] and phases[4].why. Her real R is Final Hour (enemyAbilities.R).
audit.why: Final Hour grants AD, Tumble invisibility, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more Night Hunter move speed — the fabricated name loses that context for the reader.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Final Hour (R) everywhere it appears.

audit.why: Sivir's range/wave-clear beats Vayne pre-6 (weak auto-only lane), Vayne's spikes take it post-item — matches packet levelChart (Sivir L1-6, Vayne 1st item/2+ items).
Power spikes are level 6 (Final Hour all-in window) and Kraken Slayer/Guinsoo's three-stack Silver Bolts true damage — both grounded in enemyKit W (true damage on 3rd hit) and R text.

edits.before: - Vayne Condemn: matchup-defining — Wall-stuns you — never fight her with terrain at your back. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Spell Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Vayne's Condemn (E) is down 20s early, 12s at max rank — punish the miss immediately, never fight with terrain at your back. - Your Spell Shield (E) is up every 24s early, 18s at max — save it for the wall setup, not chip poke.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bait Condemn first — the E only eats a targeted cast, so let her commit before you spend your shield.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Tumble resets her spacing on a falling cooldown — chasing into her kite trades your tempo for hers.

edits.before: On the Chase plus Spell Shield give you the cleanest all-in window at 6.
edits.after: Final Hour plus Spell Shield give you the cleanest all-in window at 6.

edits.before: On the Chase (R) gives you the movement speed to walk her down or cleanly disengage her all-in, and your Spell Shield (E) can eat a Condemn to deny the knockback-stun combo. This is your last clean window of total lane dominance before she scales, so look to force an all-in with your support's CC while you still out-DPS her Silver Bolts.
